items.text: Tonight: stay indoors with headphones on until 11pm. If the grounding exercise doesn't help within 10 minutes, text the ACT team line.
items.author: Dr. A. Rivera

items.text: Wear earplugs or noise-cancelling headphones during the fireworks window (about 9 to 11pm).
Grounding: breathe in for 1 and out for 1, then 2 and 2, up to 5 or 6.
Drink water every hour; use AC or a cooling center if home is hot.
